channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: "Hope I don't get suffocated": Govinda says wife Sunita used in a big 'conspiracy' against him
item.description: Govinda says that wife Sunita Ahuja has been unknowingly involved in a conspiracy against him by someone.

item.title: 'Parvati Paul Rao': Rajkummar Rao- Patralekhaa reveal their daughter's name, share first glimpse of newborn
item.description: Power couple Rajkummar Rao and his wife Patralekhaa, shared a heartfelt moment with their fans on Sunday as they officially revealed the name of their daughter. The couple announced that they have named their baby girl Parvati Paul Rao and posted a sweet photo of themselves holding their newborn's tiny hands.

item.title: India's first-ever open-sea marine fish farming project launched in Andaman
item.description: The project is being implemented through collaboration between the Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India, its technical arm the National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT), and the UT Administration of Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The pilot initiative focuses on open-sea cultivation of marine finfish and seaweed in natural ocean conditions, integrating scientific innovation with livelihood generation.

item.title: Delhi-NCR chokes under 'severe' pollution as AQI soars past 450
item.description: In several locations, the AQI crossed 450, while in some areas it came close to the 500 mark. Owing to these alarming pollution levels, the entire NCR is experiencing conditions akin to a gas chamber, with Delhi bearing the brunt of the crisis.

item.title: 2.8-magnitude earthquake hits Delhi, no damage reported
item.description: There were no immediate reports of casualties or property damage, and the tremors were described as mild in nature. However, the incident once again highlighted Delhi's vulnerability to seismic activity due to its geological setting.

item.title: Iran's president warns strikes on Khamenei would lead to 'all-out war'
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian warned that any attack on Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei would amount to an "all-out war" against Iran, escalating tensions with the United States. His remarks followed US President Donald Trump's call for new leadership in Iran amid ongoing protests over repression, economic hardship, and human rights abuses.

item.title: US tariff warnings raise new market concerns
item.description: Commentators across major US political shows warned that tariffs are increasingly being used as pressure tactics rather than solutions to trade disputes, raising costs without significantly boosting domestic manufacturing.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open sharply lower amid weak global cues, rising global trade tensions
item.description: As of 9.30 am, Sensex lost 449 points, or 0.54 per cent to reach 83,120 and Nifty declined 148 points, or 0.58 per cent to 25,546. Main broadcap indices performed in line with benchmark indices, with the Nifty Midcap 100 losing 0.42 per cent, and the Nifty Smallcap 100 easing 0.54 per cent.

item.title: Indian Army's Western Command holds events to mark Veterans' Day
item.description: The command highlighted its commitment to veterans through 41 Veterans Sahayata Kendras, 79 ECHS polyclinics, financial support, medical care, and initiatives like Project NAMAN for veterans and Veer Naris. Lieutenant General Manoj Kumar Katiyar and AWWA Regional President Shuchi Katiyar interacted with veterans, expressing gratitude for their lifelong service and sacrifices.

item.title: Bigg Boss Kannada 12 winner: HD Kumaraswamy congrats Gilli Nata and Rakshitha Shetty
item.description: HD Kumaraswamy has congratulated Gilli Nata on his victory as the winner of Bigg Boss Kannada 12 and Rakshitha Shetty for being runner up.
